translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Ra Torofi Jesus
Weni mwirin aaen Jesus aeni maeipin eei, iwe iiy me rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra noa reen rhan pwupwu we Kidron. Eno eew maat pwiuneoi we, iwe Jesus me rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra noa ee.
Rhooan a fang tinnimae we Judas e giuneei pwiuneoi we, pwe a gin towunap aaen Jesus me rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun renoa rhu me ee.
Iwe Judas a noa noan maat we, iiy me cchon sonotaweer Rome kkewe, iwe me aaemweoi poosun Temple we, aefengayeer soamwoonin patere me Pharisees kkewe; re itto fengaen me nimeer me oappwun me tiun.
Jesus e fasiun giuneei oanongaen meeta epwene wen ngaeni, iwe a faaeraeg ngaeniir nge a aeiineeor pwe, “Iyo mwu oaw kiukkiutta?”
Ra iura pwe, “Jesus re Nazareth.” Nge a iura pwe, “Ngaang ieei.” Rhooan a fang tinnimae we Judas e iugiu reer.
Oatowe Jesus e aengaeniir pwe, “Ngaang ieei,” nge ra mer sefaaen iwe ra ppiungtiw wooan ppweon.
Jesus a pwan aeiineeor pwe, “Iyo mwu oaw kiukkiutta?” Ra iura pwe, “Jesus re Nazareth.”
Jesus a iura pwe, “Iya moannon aengaenigaemi pwe ngaang iiy. Iwe ngaere ngaang minne oaw kiukkiuttayaei, ina nge oawpwe nigitiir noa ikka aaemweoi.” (
Jesus e aepesa minneei pwe menaen kkepas we e aengaeniir epwe pwae noa: “Semaei, esooar mwo erhai me neeiir rhooawe wo ngaenneaei ne e mwaenirh saengiaei.”)
Simon Peter, iwe e pwigi epeo saeitan, e waeititae rhag a gopiy noa peig mwaaenen saeningaen erhai rhooan akkiuneo kkewe naiun Soamwoonin Patere we. Itaen rhooan akkiuneo we nge Malchus.
Jesus a aengaeni Peter pwe, “Iseni noa saeitan mwu noawumw! Wo niuwaennei pwe isoapw iuniumi kkepaen affayeo mwu manna Semaei efang ngaeniaei?”
Jesus me Weni Mmwaen Annas
Iwe sonotawaen Rome kkewe me soamwoon kkewe aar fengaen me poos kkewe aar Jews ra torofi Jesus iwe ra geoni noa,
iwe ra pwigi noa reen Annas. Iiy minne semaen rhooan ngaenne aaen Caiaphas, iwe iiy minne Soamwoonin Patere noan raegin we.
Caiaphas minne e aengaeniir soamwoonin Jews kkewe pwe egacch igine erhai aeremas epwe mae noa faaen iteer rhooa towunap.
Peter e Iura pwe Ese Giuneei Jesus

Simon Peter me erhai rhooan kkayeo kkewe re tettapw noa weni mwirin Jesus. Iiy rhooan kkayeo we erhai iwe e fasiun gin me reen Soamwoonin Patere we, iwe a tapweei noa Jesus niugiun wororaen iimw we imwaen Soamwoonin Patere we,
iwe nge Peter iwe e iu rhag reen aesemaen iimw we. Iwe rhooan kkayeo we erhai a sefaaen wow niugiun a noa itiwow kkepas ngaeni rhooapwut we reen wororaen iimw we, iwe a noa paeni nong Peter.
Rhooapwut we reen aesemaen iimw we a aengaeni pwe, “Saapw pwan een erhai rhooan kkayeo kkewe rhoaniuwaen mwaaen naan?” Peter a iura pwe, “Aapw, saapw ngaang.”

E patapat noan oatowe, iwe rhooan akkiuneo kkewe me poos kkewe ra sonitae eew aengaet iwe ra iu roangoroangei noa pwe re aepwerhikkeraar. Iwe Peter a faaeraeg noa reer iwe a noa aepwerhikkera oanongan.
Manewe Soamwoonin Patere a Kkepas Aeiyeg Ngaeni Jesus
Soamwoonin Patere we a aeiyegiy Jesus wunuunun rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun me fenai kkewe aan.

Jesus a iura pwe, “Oanongaen aaei mwaenieniy ngaeniir rhooa towunap; me aaei fenai nge isooaw no rhag noan wutteer Jews kkewe me Temple we, pwiuneoi we oanongeer aeremas regaen itto aemmweoiu ee. Esooar faaen eew ne i mwaenieniy nge i mwaenieniy noan mwoanomwoan.
Iwe ina nge meeta faan oawwa aeiineowaei reen? Aeiineeor rhooawe re aiussaening ngaeniaei. Aeiineeor meeta we i aengaeniir — iir re giuneei meeta kkewe i aepesa.”
Oatowe Jesus e aepesa minneei, nge erhai me neeiir poos kkewe a pigiri nge a aengaeni pwe, “Meeta e ina wusun oamw kkepas ngaeni man mwu Soamwoonin Patere reen!?”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Aere eyor eew min mwaerhei ne i aepesa nge wa aengaeniir rhooa eei minne iiy. Iwe ngaere epwiung minne i aepesa, iwe nge meeta faaen oamw peosepaeyaei?”
Iwe Annas a fangenoa iiy reen Caiaphas Soamwoonin Patere we, nge e rhiuwen geeogeeo noa rhag.
Peter a Pwan Iura Sefaaeniy pwe Ese Giuneei Jesus
Peter iwe e rhiuwen iu igiwe pwe e aepwerhikkera oanongan. Iwe ra aengaeni pwe, “Saapw pwan een erhai rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun mwaaen naan?” Iwe Peter a iura pwe, “Saapw ngaang.”
Erhai me neeiir slave kkewe naiun Soamwoonin Patere we, iwe re pwugusaen mwaaen we Peter e gopiy noa saeningan, a iura pwe, “Pwe ise weriug me reen noan maat we?”
Iwe Peter a pwan iura pwe, “Saapw ngaang.” Iwe rhag nge e keokkeok noa maniug we.
Jesus me Weni Mmwaen Pilate

Nee oatosor moawugowug rhag nge ra pwigi Jesus me reen imwaen Caiaphas iwe ra pwigi noa reen imwaen governor. Soamwooniir re Jew kkewe rese toonong noan imwaen governor, pwe rete nimaenneew noa nge epwe yo aar repwe mwongo mwongoon Passover we.
Iwe Pilate a toowow niugiun a itiwow aeiineeor pwe, “Meeta minne oaw oamonofitiy aeremas een wooan?”
Ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Aeisoapw pwigito reemw igine esooar eew min aenneew ne efeeori.”
Pilate a aengaeniir pwe, “Iwe ina nge aaemi oaw pwigi iwe oawwa noa apwiungiu reen aaemi anniug.” Ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Esooar aemaem mamaaw pwe aeipwe niiy noa erhai.” (
A wen minneei pwe epwe pwaetae miniwe mwaeniaen Jesus igiwe e aemmetefa wunuunun mae na epwe aeni.)
Pilate a sefaaen nong noan iimw we imwan nge a faingi Jesus. A aeiineow pwe, “Een minne aar king re Jews?”
Jesus a iura pwe, “Kkepas aeiyeg na e itto me reemw, aere aaemweoi minne re aengaeniug mmwenei?”
Pilate a iura pwe, “Wo niuwaennei pwe ngaang erhai re Jew? Sipegin noawumw aeremas me soamwoonin patere kkomwun minikkomwu re pwigiug to reei. Meeta wa feeori?”

Jesus a iura pwe, “Minna Mweoiuy ina ese itto me reen faeinaengiy; pwe ngaere minna Mweoiuy e itto me reen faeinaengiy, nge rhooakkena rhoaniuwaei repwe moawun faaen itaei pwe ete mmwenen aar iseniaei nong noan paiiur soamwoonin Jews. Aapw, minna Mweoiuy ese no igeei!”

Iwe Pilate a aeiineow pwe, “Iwe een erhai king?” Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Een minne wo iura pwe ngaang erhai king. Faaen aaei supw me aaei noa itto noan faeinaengiy ina faaen ngaeni rhag eew aegiaeg, ipwe itto aepesa minna wenewen. Ese tiwegin iyo na e tipaeni wenewen, nge epwe rongorong ngaeniaei.”

Pilate a aeiineow pwe, “Iwe meeta minna wenewen?” Ra Aettiweginiy Aaen Jesus Mae Noa (Mat 27.15-31; Mark 15.6-20; Luke 23.13-25) Pilate a sefaaen wow reer rhooawe niugiun nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Esooar meeta iweri pwe teren mwaaen een.”
Nge eew kkomi, iwe ngaang igaen fasiun aessaenetaegiy erhai rhooan kanepwus noan gupwunon Passover. Oaw mwerhaen ipwe saeneti ngaenigaemi mane aar king Jews?”
Ra paniuwaeni reen aar aekkepwas tae, “Aapw, saapw iiy! Aei tipaeni Barabbas!” (Barabbas iwe erhai rhooa mwoarho.)
